stem:
The graphic organizer shown can be used to classify triangles.

Which triangle can be classified as scalene?

options.label: F
options.text: Triangle with two sides marked equal and one side marked different

options.label: H
options.text: Triangle with two sides marked equal and one side marked different

options.label: G
options.text: Right triangle with two sides marked equal and one side marked different

options.label: J
options.text: Triangle with two sides marked equal and one side marked different

visual_elements: Graphic organizer: Triangles divided into Scalene triangles and Isosceles triangles, with Isosceles further divided into Equilateral triangles
Four triangles labeled F, H, G, J with side markings indicating equal sides
notes: The scalene triangle is characterized by having no equal sides. The options depict triangles with side markers; the correct choice has no two sides equal.
